answer: Require every agent identity to stake a decaying reputation bond before it can join a shared garden of tasks: the bond is ferrous in the sense that it is hard to mint cheaply, earned only through verified, useful work over time, and each new identity must present a distinct cipher-linked proof of past work, signed by prior counterparties. A sybil farm can spawn thousands of names, but it cannot fabricate the work history or the bond behind each one without paying the same cost honest agents paid, so fake identities stay too expensive to flood the market.
